FC Kaysar is a Kazakh professional football club based in the Gany Muratbayev Stadium in Kyzylorda. They are founding members of the Kazakhstan Premier League and have missed only three seasons following relegations. Their most successful was the season of 1998, when they won the Kazakhstan Cup and came fourth in the league. Also they won Kazakhstan Cup in 2019.
